patch_description:
Crossover of the two best-performing seed variants (both scoring 0.89) that combined RY→ring-CRZ→RX→skip-CRZ layers, duplicated into two shared-parameter blocks. The first variant added a two-parameter "diameter" (antipodal) CRZ layer for global mixing and achieved a smaller train/val gap (0.03) but slower convergence (540 steps); the second omitted the diameter layer and converged much faster (150 steps) at the cost of a larger gap (0.06).

This version keeps the fast-converging modular block structure (RY, alternating-shared ring-CRZ, RX, single-shared skip-2 CRZ) and adds a *minimal* global entangler: a diameter (antipodal, distance-4) CRZ layer that uses a **single** shared parameter instead of two. This keeps the extra global-mixing benefit (which improved generalization gap in variant 1) while adding only one extra trainable parameter instead of two, keeping the parameter count low (20 unique parameters) and reusing the same names across both stacked block copies to preserve the fast convergence properties from variant 2. The result should combine the best of both: faster convergence, low parameter count (better parameter efficiency), and improved generalization from the added global connectivity.
